question: Could you review our records in June 2022 and identify which countries have the longest streak of consecutive inserted city dates? Please list the 2-letter length country codes of these countries.
sql:
WITH june_cities AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT country_code_2, insert_date
    FROM cities 
    WHERE insert_date LIKE '2022-06-%'
),
ordered_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        country_code_2,
        insert_date,
        LAG(insert_date, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY insert_date) as prev_date
    FROM june_cities
),
consecutive_groups AS (
    SELECT 
        country_code_2,
        insert_date,
        prev_date,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_date IS NULL THEN 1
            WHEN (CAST(insert_date AS DATE) - CAST(prev_date AS DATE)) = 1 THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END as is_new_group
    FROM ordered_dates
),
group_numbers AS (
    SELECT 
        country_code_2,
        insert_date,
        SUM(is_new_group) OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY insert_date) as group_id
    FROM consecutive_groups
),
streak_lengths AS (
    SELECT 
        country_code_2,
        group_id,
        COUNT(*) as streak_length
    FROM group_numbers
    GROUP BY country_code_2, group_id
),
max_streaks AS (
    SELECT 
        country_code_2,
        MAX(streak_length) as max_streak
    FROM streak_lengths
    GROUP BY country_code_2
)
SELECT country_code_2, max_streak FROM max_streaks WHERE max_streak = (SELECT MAX(max_streak) FROM max_streaks) ORDER BY country_code_2
